bullets.text: UK Telecoms Unite Against Scams - Major UK telcos commit to a new Telecommunications Fraud Charter to combat scam calls.
Zoom's UK Data Centre Plans - Zoom will open a UK data centre in 2026 to enhance local data residency compliance.
VMO2 Eyes £2bn Acquisition - Virgin Media O2 negotiates to acquire fibre altnet Netomnia, marking a significant market consolidation.
Equinix's £3.9bn Data Centre - Equinix plans a major data centre in Hertfordshire, boosting the UK's digital infrastructure.
O2 Partners with Starlink - O2 collaborates with Starlink to enhance connectivity for remote enterprise assets.
Telefónica's Growth Strategy - Telefónica launches a strategic plan focusing on AI and operational efficiency across key markets.
Jamf's AI Forensics Tool - Jamf introduces AI analysis for mobile forensics, enhancing threat detection for high-value users.
Changing Video Habits Create Data Challenges - UK viewers increasingly prefer app-based content, complicating data management for enterprises.
